summary: The diff adds an error-state UI to ActorInitializationGate, but it does not implement the requested actor error/readiness plumbing in useActor/useActorReady, and the provided “retry” behavior relies on full page reloads rather than a true refetch mechanism. Additionally, useActorReady still hard-codes no error state, so the gate’s error rendering is not actually tied to real initialization failures.

missing_requirements.requirement: Enhance `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` to expose explicit actor readiness and error status (e.g., `isLoading`, `isReady`, `isError`, `error`) and provide a real `refetch`/retry mechanism that consumers can call.
missing_requirements.reason: No changes to `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` are shown, and `useActorReady` indicates the base hook still “doesn't expose errors yet” and only consumes `{ actor, isFetching }`, so the required status fields and real retry/refetch are not implemented in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update `frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts` and `frontend/src/components/ActorInitializationGate.tsx` to use the new readiness/error status and display an error Alert UI (with a Retry button) when initialization fails.
missing_requirements.reason: `useActorReady` still hard-codes `isError = false` and `error = null`, and its `refetch` is implemented as `window.location.reload()` rather than exposing a real actor-query retry mechanism. `ActorInitializationGate` does not consume `isError`/`error` nor wire Retry to a refetch; it falls back to error UI whenever `!isLoading && !isReady`, and its retry action reloads the page.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the backend actor initialization flow to never leave authenticated users stuck on an indefinite “Initializing…” UI; if actor creation or `initializeAccessControl()` fails, the UI must transition to a visible error state with clear next actions.
missing_requirements.reason: While an error UI is added, the retry action uses full page reload (`window.location.reload()`), which does not meet the requirement to retry actor initialization without requiring a full page refresh. Also, because `useActorReady` does not reflect real error status, there is no evidence that actual actor initialization failures (e.g., rejected query / initializeAccessControl failure) are surfaced as an explicit error state rather than only inferred by `!isReady`.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a “Logout & Retry” action that clears Internet Identity state and reloads the page as part of the actor initialization error UI.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requires a retry mechanism for actor initialization; it does not request an additional logout flow in the initialization gate.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes described in `frontend-file-summaries.txt` such as updated color system, owed-driver calculation updates, new/updated dialogs (PDF generation, cycle balance), and other UI/feature changes unrelated to actor initialization error handling.
hallucinated_features.reason: These items are not requested in REQ-5/6/7 and are outside the stated scope/non-goals; the diff evidence shows them as newly described changes in the modified summary file.
